contradictions.resolution_suggestion: Replace 26.5%/20.48% with MMB market-wide 12.3%/13.6% in Stage 1 draft (PP1.2.5), Stage 2 draft (citation footnote 5), Stage 4 draft (pain-points footnote 9), and Stage 6 draft (citation footnote 8).
